note: The official 1999 Enchiridion, independently produced 1902 Breviarium and 1952 Enchiridion agree on all 17 substantive words, their order and the complete oration boundary. The corpus adopts customary stress accents and ae ligatures directly witnessed by the Breviarium. Its response label before Amen is excluded, while Amen itself belongs to all three witnesses. Headings, descriptive notes, indulgence matter, the surrounding Benedictio Mensae office, the benefactor prayer and the suffrage for the departed are excluded rather than conflated with the prayer.
